name: 05-마감재·체크박스
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const key = (k, o = {}, t = window) => t.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const sofa = () => JSON.stringify(v.state.furniture.sofa); const btn = () => [document.getElementById('undo').disabled, document.getElementById('redo').disabled]; const r = {}; const room = document.getElementById('finish-room').value; const f0 = v.state.floors[room]; const chips = document.querySelectorAll('#floor-chips > *'); [...chips].find(c => !c.classList.contains('on')).click(); r.바닥바뀜 = v.state.floors[room] !== f0; key('z'); r.바닥되돌림 = v.state.floors[room] === f0; const cb = [...document.querySelectorAll('#furniture-list input[type=checkbox]')].find(c => !c.disabled && c.checked); const label = cb.parentElement.textContent; const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#furniture-list input[type=checkbox]')].find(c => c.parentElement.textContent.startsWith(label.split(' · ')[0])); cb.click(); const cb1 = find(); cb1.focus(); r.숨김 = !cb1.checked; r.포커스 = document.activeElement === cb1; key('z', {}, cb1); r.체크박스포커스에서_되돌림 = find().checked; v.loadProposal('B'); key('z'); r.안불러오기_되돌림 = document.getElementById('combo-now').textContent; return r })()
